Leadville, Colorado · stay

Hotels in Leadville for cyclists

Places to stay in Leadville when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the riding, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: Leadville Trail 100 MTB.

Hotels in Leadville for cyclists, listed

  1. Historic Delaware Hotel

    $$ · 700 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461

    1886 Victorian with 36 rooms and a lobby bar on Harrison, a block from the LT100 start; three floors, steep stairs, no elevator

  2. The Timberline

    $$ · 216 Harrison Ave, Leadville, CO 80461

    Renovated motel on the south end of Harrison with kitchenette bunk units and a three-bedroom loft; consistently the town's top-rated stay

  3. Columbine Inn & Suites

    $ · 2019 N Poplar St, Leadville, CO 80461

    Value motel on the north edge of town with free breakfast and parking; a short ride to the start

  4. Inn the Clouds Hostel & Inn

    $ · 500 E 7th St, Leadville, CO 80461

    Hostel dorms and private ensuite rooms five blocks from downtown, with a full kitchen and steel bike racks in the garage from June on
